ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can record every behavior in a dolphin's training and plot the data, but only a trainer who spends each day with the animal can tell whether it avoids a movement because it is tired or afraid.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 47,300 animal trainers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 49,800 by 2034, a net increase of about 2,500 jobs, with roughly 7,100 openings each year. Median annual pay was about $38,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace animal trainers, but it will make training more scientific. AI can record behavior data, analyze progress, and monitor health, moving trainers from intuition alone toward data-supported judgment. The core of animal training is an individual relationship. Every animal has a different personality and changing condition, and only a trainer can build trust, read emotions, and adjust the pace in real time.
ai_s2_accel: AI behavior recognition that supports movement analysis
Wearable devices that monitor the physiological condition of working dogs
Digital design of positive-reinforcement training programs
Growth of remote behavior consulting and teaching platforms
ai_s2_auto: Automatic recording and analysis of training behavior
Digital animal health and diet management
Automatic training-progress reports
Automated facility-environment monitoring
ai_s3_list: Building trust so an animal wants to cooperate.
Individual judgment that reads each animal's personality and condition.
Real-time adjustment based on the animal's response during training.
Safety intuition that anticipates emotion and prevents injury.
Long-term patience through repeated training without frustration.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 3/10 score means this occupation has very low direct replacement risk from AI. The core of animal training is the individual relationship between a person and an animal, while machines can only support recording and analysis. Data makes methods more scientific, but reading an animal remains the trainer's essential craft.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low risk does not mean standing still. Trainers who use behavior data and AI analysis tools become more professional and competitive. Traditional coercive methods that ignore behavioral science will lose ground as animal-welfare standards rise.

ai_s5_persona.建议: For entry, study animal science, veterinary medicine, or behavior and intern at a dog-training organization, zoo, or aquarium. Make behavioral science and positive reinforcement central to your education, and recognize that the work is demanding and often modestly paid.

Adopt behavioral methods and data records, earn professional credentials, and advance toward working-dog training, behavior consulting, or facility training supervision. Traditional performance training must evolve; positive reinforcement and animal welfare define the direction.

Career changers can start in pet training or as dog-training assistants, build hands-on experience, and then earn credentials. In interviews, demonstrate observation and patience. A real example of reading an animal and solving a problem is more persuasive than a credential alone.

Do not treat trainers as cheap labor. Animal training is skilled work. Behavioral education, insurance, and fair pay help retain people who understand animals and protect both the facility and its animals.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automatic identification and recording of animal movements
Breaking down training goals and planning rewards

ai_s7_trends: Behavioral science and positive reinforcement are becoming industry standards, while traditional performance training contracts.
Demand for working-dog and pet training is rising, widening the shortage of professional trainers.
Data and AI tools are supporting training and making methods more scientific.

body: Animal trainers apply behavioral science and positive reinforcement to teach obedience, work, and performance tasks. They develop and carry out training plans, record behavior data, and protect animal welfare while serving working dogs and performance animals.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能记录海豚每一次训练的行为数据并生成曲线，但「它今天绕开了这个动作，是累了还是害怕」——这种状态判断，靠的是训练师和动物之间朝夕相处攒下的默契。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年动物训练师在岗约 4.73 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 4.98 万人，净增约 0.25 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.71 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.88 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代动物训练师，但会让训练更科学：行为数据记录、训练进度分析、动物健康监测都能用 AI 完成，训练师从凭直觉转向数据辅助判断。但动物训练的核心是「个体关系」——每只动物性格不同、状态随时变化，建立信任、读懂情绪、临场调整训练节奏，这些只能发生在训练师和动物之间，机器替代不了。
ai_s2_accel: AI 行为识别辅助分析动物动作
可穿戴设备监测工作犬生理状态
正向强化训练方案数字化设计
远程行为咨询与教学平台兴起
ai_s2_auto: 训练行为数据自动记录与分析
动物健康与饮食管理电子化
训练进度报表自动生成
场馆环境监测自动化
ai_s3_list: 信任建立：让动物愿意跟你合作。
个体判断：读懂每只动物的性格与状态。
临场调整：训练中根据反应实时变通。
安全直觉：预判动物情绪避免受伤。
长期耐心：重复训练不焦不躁。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业被 AI 直接替代的风险很低：动物训练的核心是人与动物的个体关系，机器只能做记录和分析的辅助。变化的重点是训练方法——数据辅助让训练更科学，但「读懂动物」这件事，永远是训练师的本行。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低风险不等于原地踏步：会用行为数据、懂 AI 分析工具的训练师更专业、更有竞争力；而固守老一套、不学行为学的传统驯兽式训练，会在动物福利要求下被淘汰。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想入行建议读动物科学、动物医学或行为学专业，假期去训犬机构、动物园实习。把行为学和正向强化当核心课，同时要有心理准备：这行收入不高、工作辛苦。
把行为学方法和数据记录用起来，考取专业认证，往工作犬训练、行为顾问或场馆训练主管走。传统表演型训练要转型，正向强化和福利理念是大方向。
转行从宠物训练、训犬助理这类入口切入，先积累实操再考认证。面试时展示你的观察力和耐心，讲一个「读懂动物并解决问题」的真实案例比证书更有说服力。
别把训练师当廉价劳动力，动物训练是专业活：给训练师匹配行为学培训、保险和合理薪酬，才能留住真正懂动物的人，也才能保障场馆与动物双方的安全。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can automate subtitle switching, restore audio and video, and run cloud broadcasts, but when a camera falls or a cable comes loose at a live venue, a technician still has to rush in and fix it.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 24,800 broadcast technicians were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decrease to 24,200 by 2034, a net loss of about 600 jobs, with approximately 1,800 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $53,900 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Broadcast Technicians, but it will change their technology stack. Automated captions, AI restoration, and cloud broadcasting are taking over repetitive technical steps and reducing entry-level roles. Machines cannot replace on-site equipment setup, signal-chain design, or emergency response during live broadcasts. Technicians who understand networks and cloud technology and can oversee complex live productions are more sought after during the industry's transition.
ai_s2_accel: AI-powered camera tracking
Adoption of virtual studios
5G remote production
AI quality control for live content
ai_s2_auto: Automated caption and teleprompter-text generation
AI audio and video restoration and enhancement
Automated broadcast switching
Cloud-broadcast signal distribution
ai_s3_list: On-site equipment setup and calibration: every venue differs, so people determine the solution.
Emergency live-broadcast repair: people restore service during countdowns after black screens or broken links.
Complex signal-chain design: people build multi-camera, multiplatform distribution systems.
Coordination with the directing team: people synchronize cues and timing.
Implementation decisions for new technology: people decide whether to move to the cloud and how to migrate.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10, moderate, means AI is taking over a meaningful share of this occupation's technical execution. Captions, restoration, and switching can be automated, while on-site work and emergency response remain human responsibilities.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Meaningful exposure does not mean high risk. AI reduces entry-level technical roles while preserving the value of on-site and emergency work. The more live broadcasting depends on technology, the more it needs technicians who understand systems and can rescue a production.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study broadcasting, digital media, or electronic information, and gain hands-on experience with campus livestreams and event production. Learn networking, cloud technology, and audio-video fundamentals instead of focusing only on traditional broadcasting.

Build networking and cloud-broadcasting skills quickly, earn relevant certifications, and move toward systems engineer or technical supervisor roles. Familiarity with AI production tools is also valuable.

An electronics or networking background is ideal, and an entry point is a technical assistant role at an events company. On your resume, specify the scale of live productions you monitored, the links you built, and the faults you resolved.

Do not hire on education alone. Assess live-production experience and emergency-response records. A technician who can independently support a large live broadcast and understands cloud technology is a core team asset.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Noise reduction, super-resolution, and color grading
Real-time alerts for packet loss and black frames
Low-latency live broadcasting from remote locations

ai_s7_trends: Cloud broadcasting and remote production are becoming mainstream. The technology stack is shifting from hardware switching to cloud orchestration, and technicians are transitioning into systems engineers.
As AI captions, restoration, and intelligent production spread, entry-level technical roles shrink while on-site and emergency skills become more valuable.
Demand from new media and e-commerce livestreaming is growing rapidly, favoring technicians who can distribute to multiple platforms and run lightweight productions.

body: Broadcast Technicians provide technical support for radio and television production. They set up and calibrate audio-video equipment, capture and transmit signals, switch and monitor live broadcasts, record material, and troubleshoot faults so program signals air safely and on time.

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 压缩的是基础技术岗，留下的是现场和应急价值——直播越依赖技术，越需要「懂系统又能救场」的技术员。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选广播电视、数字媒体或电子信息专业，多做校园直播和活动技术实践。把网络、云技术和音视频基础都学起来，别只盯着传统广电。
尽快补网络与云转播技能，考相关认证，往系统工程师、技术主管方向走。会 AI 制作工具也是加分项。
有电子、网络背景最好，可从活动公司技术助理切入。简历上多写「盯过什么规模的直播、搭过什么链路、处理过什么故障」。
招人别只看学历，要看直播实战和应急记录。能独立扛住大型直播、又懂云技术的技术员，是团队的核心资产。

ai_s7_trends: 云转播与远程制作成为主流，技术栈从硬件切换转向云端编排，技术员向系统工程师转型。
AI 字幕、修复与智能制作普及，基础技术岗收缩，现场与应急技能更值钱。
新媒体与电商直播需求大增，会多平台分发与轻量化制作的技术员吃香。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 28,300 Computer Numerically Controlled Tool Programmers employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 31,900 by 2034, a net increase of about 3,600 jobs, with about 3,100 openings per year. The 2026 median annual wage is about $65,700 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Computer Numerically Controlled Tool Programmers, but it will remove much template-only work. CAM software with AI assistance can generate toolpaths for routine parts in seconds, reducing entry-level opportunities built on memorized settings. Process expertise remains valuable. People still decide how to fixture complex parts, choose tooling strategies, control deformation, and balance quality with throughput. Those judgments depend on shop-floor experience.
ai_s2_accel: AI optimizes toolpath strategies from historical data
Adaptive cutting-parameter adjustment
Automated feature recognition and process matching
Online measurement data feeds program optimization
ai_s2_auto: Automated toolpath generation for routine parts

ai_s3_list: Process-plan design: coordinate fixturing, tools, operations, and stock allowances.
Difficult-part judgment: choose special processes for thin walls, deep cavities, and irregular shapes.
Shop-floor problem solving: find the real causes of broken tools, chatter marks, and deformation.
Operator collaboration: even a strong program depends on effective work between people and machines.
Cost and throughput awareness: programs must save time and material, not merely run correctly.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 places this career in the moderate AI exposure range. Program generation has broad AI exposure, and automation now handles much routine work.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean the role disappears. AI replaces program generation, while process-design judgment becomes more valuable. Programmers who use AI tools and understand shop-floor processes can deliver much more, increasing their scarcity.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study mechanical engineering, CNC machining, or intelligent manufacturing. Build strong CAD/CAM skills and learn machining processes. AI can replace routine programming, but not process judgment. Students need both capabilities.

Move beyond producing programs into multi-axis programming, difficult-part processes, and intelligent tool management. Use AI programming tools as assistants. Your value lies in judgment, not generation.

CNC operating experience creates a strong route into programming. Bring program samples and trial-cut improvement records to interviews. High-end manufacturers value proven work more than certificates alone.

Do not treat programmers as toolpath generators, because AI already handles much of that work. Hire versatile programmers who understand processes, work on the shop floor, and optimize plans with AI tools.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Virtual verification of the full process

ai_s7_trends: AI-based automatic programming becomes standard, shifting programmers toward process design and difficult parts.
Five-axis and multi-axis programming demand grows with advanced manufacturing, sustaining premiums for scarce talent.
Digital twins and closed-loop online measurement move program optimization from experience-driven to data-driven work.

body: Computer Numerically Controlled Tool Programmers write and debug machining programs for CNC equipment. They build three-dimensional models from drawings, design toolpaths, set parameters, verify simulations, and optimize trial cuts.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can generate toolpaths automatically. Computer Numerically Controlled Tool Programmers still create value, but only when they understand machining processes.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动生成刀路了，CNC 程序员还有价值吗？有，但只留给懂工艺的人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年计算机在岗约 2.83 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 3.19 万人，净增约 0.36 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.31 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.57 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代 CNC 程序员，但会清理掉「只会套模板」的那一批：现在的 CAM 软件加 AI 辅助，几秒钟就能生成常规件的刀路，过去靠背参数混饭的新手空间被大幅压缩。真正留下来的是懂工艺的人——复杂件怎么装夹、用什么刀具策略、怎么控制变形、怎么在质量和效率之间取舍，这些判断 AI 给不了，需要现场经验支撑。
ai_s2_accel: AI 依据历史数据优化刀路策略
切削参数自适应调整
加工特征自动识别与工艺匹配
在线测量数据反哺程序优化
ai_s2_auto: 常规零件刀路的自动生成
加工参数的智能推荐
仿真碰撞检查自动化
后处理程序自动生成
ai_s3_list: 工艺方案设计：装夹、刀具、工序、余量的通盘规划。
疑难件判断：薄壁、深腔、异形件的特殊工艺处理。
现场问题处置：崩刀、振纹、变形背后的真实原因。
与操作员协作：程序再好，也要现场人机配合。
成本与效率意识：程序不只要对，还要省时省料。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明编程生成环节的 AI 接触面大，常规工作正在被自动化和 AI 大量代劳，属于中高曝光。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于岗位消失：被替代的是「生成程序」的动作，被加码的是「设计工艺」的判断。会 AI 编程工具、又懂现场工艺的程序员，一个人能顶过去几个人，稀缺性反而上升。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读机械、数控或智能制造专业，把 CAD/CAM 练熟的同时一定学加工工艺。编程会被 AI 替代，工艺不会——两手都硬的学生是制造企业的抢手货。
别满足于「会出程序」，往多轴编程、疑难件工艺、智能刀具管理方向走。把 AI 编程工具用起来当助手，你的价值在判断不在生成。
有数控操作经验再转编程最顺。求职时带上自己做过的程序案例和试切改进记录，比证书更有说服力，高端行业更看重作品。
别把程序员当「刀路生成器」用，AI 已能代劳。招懂工艺、能下车间、会优化方案的复合程序员，配合 AI 工具，交付质量与效率都会上一个台阶。

ai_s7_trends: AI 自动编程成为标配，程序员重心全面转向工艺设计与疑难件。
五轴与多轴编程需求随高端制造扩张，稀缺人才溢价持续。
数字孪生与在线测量闭环，程序优化从经验驱动转向数据驱动。

body: 计算机数控程序员负责编写和调试数控机床的加工程序：依据零件图纸建立三维模型、设计刀路、设定加工参数、进行仿真验证，并配合试切优化。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能自动生成刀路了，CNC 程序员还有价值吗？有，但只留给懂工艺的人。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can turn a recording into mostly accurate text, but a reporter still decides what belongs in the record, which terms need notation, and how to preserve legal validity.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) reports that about 17,700 court reporters and simultaneous captioners were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to remain at 17,700 by 2034, a net gain of about 0 jobs, with roughly 1,700 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $67,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace court reporters and simultaneous captioners as a whole, but it will take over lower-end settings. Speech recognition already handles many routine meetings and simple live captions. Judicial records and real-time captions require accuracy and legal validity, shifting reporters toward reviewing and approving AI transcripts. The key skill is moving from fast typing to sound judgment.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted real-time captioning and correction
Automatic terminology replacement and consistency
Speech transcription + human review workflow
AI-assisted multilingual caption translation
ai_s2_auto: Automatic first-draft speech transcription
Automated basic meeting records
Automatic caption timeline segmentation
Standardized text formatting
ai_s3_list: Legal validity control: record format and evidentiary status.
Terminology and context judgment: homophones, dialects, and proper names.
High-speed listening: people take over when AI falls behind.
Annotations and markers: standardized treatment of speakers, objections, and pauses.
Confidentiality and neutrality: remain reliable in sensitive proceedings.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places court reporting in the moderate AI exposure range for text technology roles. Speech recognition lowers the transcription barrier and replaces mechanical tasks. Judicial records still demand accuracy, legal validity, and immediacy, making human-AI collaboration the standard while reducing space for typing-only reporters.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure is a signal to change skills. Do not compete with AI on typing speed. Reporters who operate transcription tools, correct drafts quickly, and understand legal text standards can handle more work.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Do not treat pure shorthand as a safe educational bet because speech recognition is improving quickly. Build legal writing and language skills. Learn stenotype alongside speech tools, then target real-time captions and legal text rather than typing-only work.

Master AI transcription tools and move from manual shorthand toward an AI draft + human review workflow. Advanced certification can open paths into real-time captioning, legal editing, and team management, where rates and differentiation are stronger.

People with strong language skills and transcription basics can enter, but choose the target setting carefully. Court systems are stable but have high barriers. Live captions and meeting records are easier to enter but highly competitive. Emphasize accuracy, composure, and sensitivity to terminology.

Design reporting roles around human-AI collaboration. Use AI transcription for drafts and people for review, improving efficiency. Treat proficiency with speech tools as a hiring advantage instead of focusing only on traditional stenography.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Slow playback to verify transcription differences
Consistent replacement of names and technical terms

ai_s7_trends: Speech recognition is spreading, moving reporting work toward human-AI collaboration.
Demand for real-time captions and accessibility services is growing.
Reporters are shifting toward legal text expertise and caption operations.

body: Court reporters and simultaneous captioners create verbatim records and formal transcripts of trials, hearings, and meetings. They also provide synchronized captions for television and online broadcasts, using high-speed input, speech-recognition review, and legal text standards.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can turn a recording into mostly accurate text, but a reporter still decides what belongs in the record, which terms need notation, and how to preserve legal validity.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能把录音转成九成对的文字，但「哪句该记、哪个词要标注、怎么保证法律效力」，还得记录员来定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年法庭记录员与实时字幕员在岗约 1.77 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.77 万人，净增约 0.00 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.17 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.73 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会整体取代法庭记录员，但会吃掉低端场景：普通会议、简单直播的字幕已大量用语音识别。司法记录和实时字幕的「准确性 + 法律效力」要求，让记录员转为「AI 转写的校对者 + 把关人」，技能要求从「打字快」转向「判断准」。
ai_s2_accel: 实时字幕 AI 辅打与纠错
术语库自动替换统一
语音转写+人工复核流程
多语种字幕辅助翻译
ai_s2_auto: 语音识别初稿生成
基础会议记录自动化
字幕时间轴自动切分
文本格式规范化
ai_s3_list: 法律效力把关：记录格式与证据属性。
术语与语境判断：同音词、方言、专名。
高速跟听：AI 跟不上时人顶上。
标注与标记：发言人、异议、停顿的规范处理。
守密与中立：在敏感程序中保持可靠。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明法庭记录是「中度 AI 曝光」的文字技术岗：语音识别把转写门槛拉低，机械场景被替代；但司法记录对准确性、法律效力和即时性的要求，让「人机协作」成为主流，纯打字型的记录员空间收窄。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光提醒记录员转型：别跟 AI 比打字，要比「把关」——熟练操作 AI 转写工具、能快速校对纠错、懂法律文本规范的记录员，反而接得住更多活。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 不建议把「纯速记」当专业赌注：语音识别进步太快。真想走这条路，把法律文书、语言功底打扎实，学速记机的同时学语音工具协作，往实时字幕、法律文本方向走，比纯打字更抗替代。
把 AI 转写工具用到熟，从「手动速记」转向「AI 初稿 + 人工把关」的工作流；考取更高级认证，往实时字幕、法律编辑、团队管理走，单价和不可替代性都更高。
有文字功底、听打基础的人可以入行，但先想清楚目标场景：法院系统稳定但门槛高，直播字幕和会议记录门槛低但竞争激烈。求职时突出「准确性 + 抗压 + 术语敏感度」。
建议把记录岗设计成「人机协作」：配好 AI 转写工具，让人做校对把关，效率更高；同时在招聘时把「熟练语音工具」列为加分项，别只盯传统速记背景。

ai_s7_trends: 语音识别普及，记录工作转向人机协作。
实时字幕与无障碍服务需求增长。
记录员向法律文本专家与字幕运营转型。

body: 法庭记录员与实时字幕员负责对法庭庭审、听证与会议进行逐字记录并制作正式文本，或为电视、网络直播提供同步字幕，结合高速录入技能、语音识别校对与法律文本规范。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能把录音转成九成对的文字，但「哪句该记、哪个词要标注、怎么保证法律效力」，还得记录员来定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Systems can automate circuit simulation and testing, but engineers still define the architecture, judge electromagnetic behavior, and integrate the system.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 192,000 Electrical Engineers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 205,700 by 2034, a net increase of about 13,700 jobs, with about 11,700 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $111,900 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Electrical Engineers, but it will accelerate simulation. Automation takes over routine simulation and testing, shifting engineers toward system architecture, electromagnetic judgment, cross-domain integration, and reliability review. Workers limited to routine simulation face pressure; engineers with architecture skills gain value.
ai_s2_accel: Smart architecture recommendations
Layout optimization
Intelligent failure alerts
Yield prediction
ai_s2_auto: Automated circuit simulation
Automated test execution
Automated reporting
Automated parameter sweeps
ai_s3_list: System architecture: people select the design.
Electromagnetic judgment: people provide practical insight.
Cross-domain integration: people make trade-offs.
Cross-domain coordination: people align teams.
Reliability review: people provide rigor.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 means moderate-high AI exposure. Systems accelerate simulation, while people still own architecture and integration.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high job risk. AI replaces routine simulation tasks, not system-architecture roles. Engineers who design architectures and integrate systems become scarcer as tools improve; those limited to simulation face the most pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start with electrical or electronic engineering and practice system-level design. Routine simulation is shrinking, so develop architecture skills early.
Progress from running simulations to designing systems and managing electromagnetic compatibility. Learn integration and certification and pursue large projects.
Highlight system and certification experience, including the products you developed. Employers value reliability and accuracy.
Do not hire only for calculation ability. Test architecture judgment; engineers who integrate systems merit higher pay.

ai_s7_trends: Simulation automation becomes widespread.
System integration creates opportunities.
Engineers who design architectures and integrate systems become more sought after.

body: Electrical Engineers design electrical systems and equipment. They integrate circuits, motors, control systems, and electromagnetic compatibility to deliver safe, stable, and efficient electrical functions.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Systems can automate circuit simulation and testing, but engineers still define the architecture, judge electromagnetic behavior, and integrate the system.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 系统能自动仿真和测电路，但架构怎么定、电磁怎么判、系统怎么集，还是工程师定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年电气工程师在岗约 19.20 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 20.57 万人，净增约 1.37 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.17 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 11.19 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代电气工程师，但会加速仿真环节。自动化接管常规仿真与测试，工程师从「跑仿真」挪向「系统架构、电磁判断、跨域集成与可靠性把关」。真正被挤掉的是只做常规仿真的人，有架构力的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 架构智能推荐
layout 优化
失效智能预警
良率预测
ai_s2_auto: 电路自动仿真
测试自动跑
报表自动出
参数自动扫
ai_s3_list: 系统架构：选型靠人。
电磁判断：手感靠人。
跨域集成：取舍靠人。
跨域协调：对齐靠人。
可靠性把关：严谨靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的电气区——仿真被系统加速，但架构与集成还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「跑常规仿真」动作，不是「系统架构」的岗位。有架构力、能集成的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只做仿真的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 电气 / 电子起步多练系统，AI 时代纯仿真在缩，早点练架构。
从「跑仿真」升级成「做系统 + 管电磁」，学集成与认证，争取大项目。
突出系统与认证经历，写清做过哪些产品。企业看重稳和准。
选人别只看会算，要看有没有架构脑子。能集成的骨干值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 仿真自动化普及。
系统集成带来机会。
能架构集成的更抢手。

body: Electrical Engineers（中文名查表缺失）设计电气系统与设备，统筹电路、电机、控制与电磁兼容，运用电工电子实现安全、稳定、高效的电能功能。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 系统能自动仿真和测电路，但架构怎么定、电磁怎么判、系统怎么集，还是工程师定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Kiosks can handle payment and phones can take orders, but people still greet customers at the counter and pack meals quickly and accurately during rush periods.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 3,796,000 Fast Food And Counter Workers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 4,029,200 by 2034, a net increase of about 233,200 jobs, with about 904,300 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $30,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI and automation will not immediately replace Fast Food And Counter Workers, but they will change the work. Self-service kiosks, mobile ordering, and smart kitchen equipment are absorbing order-taking, payment, and some food preparation. Workers shift toward meal assembly, customer service, store operations, and equipment care. Machines cannot fully replace face-to-face service, flexible order handling, or on-site problem solving.
ai_s2_accel: Expansion of unattended checkout and self-service pickup lockers
Automated meal assembly with smart kitchen equipment
AI scheduling and store-management systems
Pilot programs for food-delivery robots
ai_s2_auto: Self-service kiosk and QR-code ordering
Automated checkout through smart point-of-sale systems
Automatic acceptance and printing of delivery orders
Automatic drink dispensing
ai_s3_list: Warm face-to-face service: people shape the experience from arrival to departure.
Rush-period meal assembly: workers stay fast and accurate as orders accumulate.
Flexible order handling: workers adapt to add-ons, dietary restrictions, and takeout requests.
Store operations knowledge: workers handle stocking, cleaning, and minor equipment problems.
Emotional control: workers avoid conflict with difficult customers.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 indicates low-moderate AI exposure. Self-service ordering, checkout, and order intake can automate part of the order-taking and payment workflow.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure still carries risk. Self-service equipment reduces cashier-only roles, but meal assembly, service, and store operations still require many workers. Employees who only take orders face pressure, while versatile workers who serve customers, understand operations, and lead shifts are more resilient.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Use this role as a transitional or entry-level job rather than a long-term destination. For a restaurant career, learn store management or food-service operations and pursue store-manager roles.
Learn self-service equipment, smart systems, and store operations. Apply for trainer or shift-leader roles. Moving from crew member to manager creates the clearest income gains.
Entry barriers are low. Start at a fast-food chain and learn the full workflow. On your resume, list the stations you handled, ordering systems you used, and shifts you led.
Do not hire solely by the hour. Retain dependable employees who want to learn operations. Clear advancement paths can reduce turnover substantially.

ai_s7_trends: Self-service ordering and smart equipment are spreading. Counter workers are shifting from order-taking and checkout to meal assembly, customer service, and store operations. Digital equipment is becoming standard.
Fast food is a large, high-turnover industry. Employees with management and operations skills have more opportunities to advance into store and regional management.
Unattended checkout and delivery robots remain in pilot use. Cashier-only roles decline, while service and operations roles remain more stable.

body: Fast Food And Counter Workers take orders, process payments, assemble and pack meals, prepare drinks, heat food, and serve customers at fast-food restaurants, restaurants, and food counters. They are frontline service workers in food retail.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Kiosks can handle payment and phones can take orders, but people still greet customers at the counter and pack meals quickly and accurately during rush periods.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自助机替你收银、手机替你点单，但高峰时柜台前那声「您好、您要点什么」、打包时那手又快又稳的活，还得靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年食品柜台工人在岗约 379.60 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 402.92 万人，净增约 23.32 万个岗位，年均产生约 90.43 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.05 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 和自动化不会立刻取代快餐与柜台工人，但会改变工作内容。自助点餐机、扫码下单、智能厨房设备正在接管点餐收银和部分制作，员工从「点单收银」转向「配餐服务、门店运营、设备维护」。面对面的服务、灵活处理订单和门店现场的问题，是机器替代不了的核心。
ai_s2_accel: 无人收银与自助取餐柜扩张
智能厨房设备自动化配餐
AI 排班与门店管理系统
机器人送餐试点
ai_s2_auto: 自助点餐机扫码下单
智能收银系统自动结算
外送订单自动接单打印
智能饮料机自动出杯
ai_s3_list: 面对面服务的亲和力：顾客进门到出门，体验靠人。
高峰配餐的节奏：单子再多，手不能乱、不能错。
灵活处理订单：加料、忌口、外带要求，现场应变。
门店运营的常识：备货、清洁、设备小故障，样样会。
情绪管理的能力：遇到难缠顾客，不跟人起冲突。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业有一部分点餐收银环节正在被自动化——自助点单、收银、接单，机器都能帮上忙。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于零风险。自助设备确实会减少纯收银岗，但配餐、服务和门店运营依然大量需要人。真正该担心的是「只做点单收银」，会服务、懂运营、能带班的多面手更稳。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 可作为过渡兼职或起步工作，不建议作长期方向。想长期走餐饮，学门店管理或餐饮运营，往店长方向发展。
把自助设备、智能系统和门店运营学起来，主动申请训练员、值班组长。从「员工」升级为「管理者」，收入才有实质提升。
门槛低随时可入行，先去连锁快餐学全套流程。简历上多写「做过什么岗位、会不会用点餐系统、有没有带过班」。
别只按小时招人，要留住愿意学运营、能稳定下来的员工。给晋升路径，流动率会低很多。

ai_s7_trends: 自助点餐与智能设备普及，柜台工人从「点单收银」转向「配餐服务、门店运营」，数字化设备成为标配。
快餐行业规模庞大、流动性高，会管理、懂运营的员工向店长和管理层晋升的机会更多。
无人收银与机器人送餐试点，纯点餐收银岗减少，服务与运营类岗位相对稳定。

body: 快餐与柜台工人在快餐店、餐厅与食品柜台负责点餐、收银、配餐、打包、饮品制作与食品加热，为顾客提供快速便捷的餐饮服务，是餐饮零售链条中的一线服务岗位。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 自助机替你收银、手机替你点单，但高峰时柜台前那声「您好、您要点什么」、打包时那手又快又稳的活，还得靠人。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Systems can compare figures automatically, but Financial examiners still decide which institutions show warning signs, how to classify findings, and what enforcement action is proportionate.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), employment of Financial examiners is projected to rise from about 65,100 in 2024 to 77,200 in 2034. That is a net increase of about 12,100 jobs, with roughly 5,700 openings each year. The median annual wage is about $90,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Financial examiners, but it will reduce manual checking. Regulatory technology and automated reporting accelerate statement comparisons. Examiners are shifting from matching figures to risk assessment, investigative interviews, enforcement discretion, and policy improvement. Mechanical checking faces the most pressure. People with strong assessment and judgment skills become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Risk-model alerts
Unusual relationship detection
AI-assisted workpaper collection
Enforcement recommendations
ai_s2_auto: Automated financial statement comparison
Automated data reporting
Automated transaction screening
Automated document generation
ai_s3_list: Risk assessment: people classify warning signs.
Investigative interviews: people evaluate explanations.
Enforcement discretion: people determine severity.
Policy improvement: people close gaps.
Regulatory communication: people set the interpretation.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this career in the moderate-high exposure range for financial examination. Systems accelerate manual checks, while people still assess risks and exercise enforcement discretion.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high career risk. Automation replaces mechanical checking, not risk assessment. Examiners with assessment and enforcement judgment become scarcer as productivity rises. Staff who only compare figures face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: If you are starting in finance or law, build knowledge of regulations and accounting. Pure checking is shrinking in the AI era, so practice risk assessment early.
Move from checking to assessment and enforcement judgment. Earn relevant credentials and seek responsibility for special examinations.
Highlight examination and compliance experience. State which institutions you have reviewed. Regulators value consistent, accurate work.
Do not hire based only on attention to detail. Look for risk judgment. Examiners who can classify findings merit higher-level roles.

ai_s7_trends: Regulatory technology is spreading, reducing manual roles.
Risk assessment and enforcement discretion create opportunities.
Examiners with strong judgment are in greater demand.

body: Financial examiners apply laws and regulations to review compliance and risk at banks, insurers, and other financial institutions. They verify statements, investigate suspicious transactions, and assess capital and internal controls, protecting financial-system integrity.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Systems can compare figures automatically, but Financial examiners still decide which institutions show warning signs, how to classify findings, and what enforcement action is proportionate.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 系统能自动比数，但哪家机构有隐患、怎么定性、处罚裁量谁来定，还是审查员定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年金融审查员在岗约 6.51 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 7.72 万人，净增约 1.21 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.57 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 9.04 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代金融审查员，但会压缩手工核对。监管科技与自动报送把报表比对提速，审查员从「对数字」挪向「风险研判、定性访谈、处罚裁量、制度改进」。真正被挤掉的是只做机械核对的，有研判和裁量力的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 风险模型预警
异常关系识别
底稿智能归集
处罚裁量建议
ai_s2_auto: 报表自动比对
数据自动报送
交易自动筛查
文书自动生成
ai_s3_list: 风险研判：隐患靠人定。
定性访谈：说辞靠人辨。
处罚裁量：轻重靠人量。
制度改进：漏洞靠人补。
监管沟通：口径靠人拿。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的审查区——手工核对被系统加速，但研判与裁量还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「机械核对」动作，不是「风险研判」的岗位。有研判和裁量力的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会比数字的对账员。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 财经/法律起步多练法规和财务，AI 时代纯核对在缩，早点练研判。
从「核对」升级成「研判 + 裁量」，考资格证争取负责专项。
突出审查和合规经验，写清跟过哪些机构。监管看重稳和准。
选人别只看细心，要看有没有研判脑子。能定性的骨干，值得给高职级。

ai_s7_trends: 监管科技普及，手工岗缩。
风险研判与裁量带来机会。
有裁量力的人更抢手。

body: 金融审查员依据法规对银行、保险等金融机构做合规与风险审查，核查报表、追查可疑交易、评估资本与内控，是金融安全中的审查把关角色。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 系统能自动比数，但哪家机构有隐患、怎么定性、处罚裁量谁来定，还是审查员定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can build a schedule, but it cannot reassign a crew to unload freight during a rainstorm.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 609,600 First Line Supervisors Of Helpers, Laborers, And Material Movers, Hand employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 632,200 by 2034, a net increase of about 22,600 jobs, with roughly 61,300 openings each year. The median annual wage is about $61,900 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace on-site supervisors, but systems will increasingly handle scheduling, statistics, and reports. Supervisors create value on the floor by coordinating labor, handling disruptions, and enforcing safety. These duties cannot be performed from an office.
ai_s2_accel: Safety monitoring: cameras and AI detect unsafe work and issue alerts
Equipment dispatch: AGVs and intelligent systems take over some material movement
Performance analysis: systems analyze operating efficiency for supervisors
Training assistance: AR and video materials assist new-worker training
ai_s2_auto: Scheduling and dispatch: intelligent systems build rosters by shift and skill
Time and attendance records: badge scans and facial recognition calculate hours automatically
Workload reports: operating data produces daily and weekly reports automatically
Inventory and task allocation: systems dispatch material-handling tasks by priority
ai_s3_list: On-site coordination and staffing. Systems create schedules, but supervisors still adjust when trucks arrive late in rain or workers call out.
Safety management and emergency judgment. Experience determines the first response and sequence when equipment fails, freight collapses, or someone is injured.
Leadership and motivation. Algorithms cannot decide how to assign inexperienced workers or manage conflict among experienced staff in a way the crew accepts.
On-site communication across operations. Drivers, warehouse staff, and production teams all need service, and supervisors set priorities.
Hands-on knowledge and backup capacity. Machines and people both fail, so supervisors need to step in when required.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this career in the moderate AI exposure range. Scheduling, records, and reports follow clear rules that AI can handle. Coordination, emergencies, and leadership resist standardization and remain on-site responsibilities.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high risk. Once systems handle scheduling and reporting, supervisors can focus on operations. On-site experience becomes more valuable, not less.

ai_s5_persona.advice: Do not focus only on credentials. Spend time in front-line logistics or warehousing, start as a helper, and build experience leading a team.
Learn intelligent scheduling and warehouse systems. Let systems calculate while you monitor operations and safety. That combination supports advancement.
Physically capable workers with shift-lead experience are in demand. State how many people you led and which operations you managed on your resume; that evidence often matters more than education.
Screen candidates for safety records and shift-lead reputation. Add intelligent dispatch systems to reduce administrative work so reports do not overwhelm supervisors.

ai_s7_trends: Intelligent scheduling and dispatch become standard, moving administrative work from supervisors to systems
AGVs and collaborative robots handle repetitive material movement, making human-machine coordination standard
AI safety monitoring becomes standard, shifting supervisors from watching workers toward monitoring systems and resolving exceptions

body: First Line Supervisors Of Helpers, Laborers, And Material Movers, Hand directly supervise and coordinate the daily work of helpers, laborers, and manual material movers. They schedule shifts, assign tasks, monitor progress and safety, and resolve on-site disruptions.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can build a schedule, but it cannot reassign a crew to unload freight during a rainstorm.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 会排班，但不会替你在暴雨天调人卸货。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年一线主管帮工、劳工、物料搬运工、手工在岗约 60.96 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 63.22 万人，净增约 2.26 万个岗位，年均产生约 6.13 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.19 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: 直接回答：AI 不会取代现场主管这个岗位，但排班、统计、报表这类案头工作会越来越多地交给系统。主管的核心价值在现场——协调人手、处理突发、管住安全，这些是坐不了办公室的活。
ai_s2_accel: 安全监测：摄像头与 AI 识别违规作业并告警
设备调度：AGV 与智能调度系统接管部分搬运
绩效分析：系统自动分析作业效率供主管参考
培训辅助：AR / 视频课件辅助新人培训
ai_s2_auto: 排班与调度：智能排班系统按班次、技能自动排表
工时与考勤记录：扫码打卡、人脸识别自动统计
工作量报表：作业数据自动汇总生成日报周报
库存与任务分配：系统按优先级自动派发搬运任务
ai_s3_list: 现场协调与人手调配。系统排了班，但下雨天车晚到、人请假，怎么现场变阵还得靠你。
安全管理与应急判断。设备故障、货物倒塌、人员受伤，第一反应和处理顺序是经验堆出来的。
带人和激励。新人不熟练、老员工闹情绪，怎么安排才服众，算法给不了答案。
与上下游的现场沟通。司机、仓储、生产都在催，怎么分清轻重缓急。
一线手感与兜底能力。机器和人都会掉链子，主管得能上手顶上。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 评分 5/10 的逻辑：这个岗位一半是案头活（排班、记录、报表）——规则清晰，AI 能接手；另一半是现场活（协调、应急、带人）——没法标准化。所以是中高曝光分。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险。排班和报表被系统接管后，主管能更专注现场，反而是「现场经验」变得更值钱而不是更便宜。

ai_s5_persona.advice: 想走这条路，别只盯文凭，先去物流、仓储一线干一两年，从帮工做起往上带团队。
主动学智能排班和仓储系统，让系统替你算，你腾出手盯现场和安全，这就是你的晋升资本。
体力好、有带班经验的人很抢手。把「带过几人、管过什么现场」写进简历，比学历有用。
筛人先看安全记录和带班口碑，再配智能调度系统减轻案头负担，别让主管被报表淹死。

ai_s7_trends: 智能排班与调度全面普及，主管的案头活被系统接管
AGV 与协作机器人分担重复搬运，人机协同成为常态
安全 AI 监控成为标配，主管从「盯人」转向「盯系统 + 处理异常」

body: 一线主管帮工、劳工、物料搬运工、手工直接监督和协调帮工、劳工与手工物料搬运工的日常活动：安排排班、分配任务、盯进度、管安全，也处理现场突发的各种状况。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 会排班，但不会替你在暴雨天调人卸货。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can predict casting defects from pouring data, but workers still judge sand moisture and core compaction by touch and experience.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 12,700 Foundry Mold And Coremakers employed in 2024. Employment is projected to fall to 9,400 by 2034, a net decrease of about 3,300 jobs, with roughly 900 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $45,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Foundry Mold And Coremakers, but it will take over more data and inspection work. Pouring records, AI vision inspection, and process recommendations are spreading. Workers increasingly adjust processes with data instead of relying only on intuition. Making molds and cores, closing molds, and diagnosing defects still depend on practical skill.
ai_s2_accel: Automated molding lines and robots replace some manual molding
3D-printed sand molds speed prototyping of complex castings
Process simulation improves pouring and cooling plans
Smart temperature and pouring systems improve quality consistency
ai_s2_auto: Automatic recording of pouring and molding parameters
AI vision inspection of casting surface defects
Digital testing of molding-sand properties
Systematic production planning and scheduling
ai_s3_list: Tactile judgment: workers assess sand moisture and compaction by hand and sight.
Defect diagnosis: identify causes of sand inclusions, blowholes, and shrinkage porosity.
Mold experience: close and repair different molds correctly.
On-site response: act quickly when pouring conditions change.
Safety instinct: recognize hazards around high-temperature molten metal.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 reflects work centered on manual production and experience. Algorithms can automate data records, defect inspection, and scheduling. Physical molding, coremaking, and defect diagnosis still require skilled workers in the near term.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure still changes the job. Automated molding lines and AI defect inspection are expanding. Foundry workers who operate automated equipment and understand process data have stronger prospects. Purely manual molding roles are shrinking, while combined equipment and process skills remain scarce.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Vocational programs in foundry work or materials forming provide a relevant path. Students should expect factory work and difficult conditions. Automated molding and 3D-printed sand molds offer better long-term prospects than purely manual molding.
Learn automated molding lines, AI defect inspection, and process simulation. Move from manual molding into combined equipment and process work, then pursue technician or team-lead roles.

A machinery or materials background supports a faster transition. Start with sand mixing and molding fundamentals, then add equipment-operation skills. Foundry work is demanding, but skilled-worker shortages reduce competition.

Foundry technicians are hard to recruit. Retain them with heat allowances, skill-based pay, and investment in automated equipment. Train younger workers who adopt new processes for senior technical roles.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Rapid production of complex sand molds
Simulation of pouring and cooling plans
Control of temperature and pouring speed

ai_s7_trends: Automated molding lines and 3D-printed sand molds are expanding, reducing purely manual molding roles.
AI defect inspection and process simulation are becoming standard, making quality control more data-driven.
Greener foundries and tighter environmental requirements are pushing workers toward combined technical skills.

body: Foundry Mold And Coremakers make and install sand molds and cores, maintain patterns, close molds, and assist with pouring. They create accurate cavities for molten metal and directly influence casting dimensions and internal quality.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can predict casting defects from pouring data, but workers still judge sand moisture and core compaction by touch and experience.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能根据浇注数据预测铸件缺陷，但砂子该多湿、砂芯该多实——这些手感，还得铸造工自己心里有数。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年铸造模具型芯工在岗约 1.27 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.94 万人，岗位净减约 0.33 万个，年均产生约 0.09 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.57 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代铸造模具与型芯工，但会接管数据和检测：浇注参数记录、缺陷检测（AI 视觉）、工艺优化建议都在普及，工人的角色从「凭经验猜」变成「按数据调」。但造型、制芯、合箱的现场操作，以及缺陷成因的判断，仍然依赖人的手和经验。
ai_s2_accel: 自动化造型线与机械手替代部分手工造型
3D 打印砂型用于复杂铸件快速试制
工艺仿真优化浇注与冷却方案
智能温控与浇注系统提升质量一致性
ai_s2_auto: 浇注与造型参数自动记录
AI 视觉自动检测铸件表面缺陷
型砂性能检测数据化
生产计划与排产系统化
ai_s3_list: 手感判断：型砂湿度、紧实度全凭手和眼。
缺陷诊断：砂眼、气孔、缩松的成因判断。
模具经验：不同模具的合箱与修补技巧。
现场应变：浇注异常时的快速处理。
安全本能：高温金属液环境的风险意识。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这行核心是现场手工与经验，能被算法自动化的主要是数据记录、缺陷检测和排产；造型制芯的物理操作和缺陷判断，短期内仍需熟练工人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于不变：自动化造型线和 AI 缺陷检测在普及，会操作自动化设备、懂工艺数据的铸造工更抢手。纯手工造型的岗位在收缩，但「设备 + 工艺」复合型工人缺口持续。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 职业院校的铸造或材料成型专业可以学，但要做好「进厂 + 环境艰苦」的心理准备。建议孩子往自动化造型、3D 打印砂型这些新技术方向走，比纯手工造型有前途。
把自动化造型线、AI 缺陷检测和工艺仿真学起来，从「手工造型工」升级成「设备 + 工艺」的复合型人才，往技师和班组长方向走。
有机械或材料背景的转铸造上手快；进厂先学混砂和造型基本功，再把设备操作补上。铸造虽苦，但技术工种缺口大、竞争小。
铸造技术工人难招，用「高温补贴 + 技能等级工资 + 自动化设备投入」留人；愿意学新工艺的年轻工人值得定向培养成技术骨干。

ai_s7_trends: 自动化造型线与 3D 打印砂型普及，纯手工造型岗位收缩。
AI 缺陷检测与工艺仿真成为标配，质量管控数据化。
绿色铸造与环保要求升级，铸造技术工人向复合型转型。

body: 铸造模具与型芯工负责铸造生产中砂型、砂芯的制作与安装、模具维护、合箱与浇注配合，通过造型制芯为金属液提供准确的型腔，是决定铸件尺寸精度与内在质量的核心工序岗。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能根据浇注数据预测铸件缺陷，但砂子该多湿、砂芯该多实——这些手感，还得铸造工自己心里有数。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can help create drawings, plan materials, and diagnose faults, but wires and screws at a worksite still require hands to connect them one by one.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 66,600 electrician helpers employed in 2024, projected to reach 66,700 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 100 jobs, with roughly 6,800 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $39,900 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace electrician helpers, but this role is inherently transitional: its value lies in opening the door to becoming a licensed electrician. AI is taking over desk-based work such as drawing generation, material scheduling, and fault diagnosis, while machines cannot replace the physical craft of on-site wiring, connection, installation, and repair. The real risk for helpers is remaining in support work without earning credentials and advancing.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted electrical fault diagnosis
Rising demand for smart-home and intelligent power-distribution installation
Wider adoption of BIM and digital construction drawings
Prefabricated cable trays and modular construction reduce wall-channel cutting
ai_s2_auto: Automatic generation of material lists and drawings
Worksite scheduling and tool-inventory management
Digital wiring records and acceptance documentation
Online safety training and procedures
ai_s3_list: Hands-on field craft: machines cannot enter every worksite to pull cable, cut channels, and make connections.
Coordination with the electrician: a helper's value lies in keeping pace and handing over the right item at the right moment.
Real-time safety judgment: experience and discipline provide protection at heights and around energized equipment.
Matching drawings to equipment: connecting plans with physical components is foundational to advancement.
Commitment to career progression: earning credentials, learning on the job, and accumulating hours require personal effort.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 score means this occupation's processes and support tasks are being automated, with systems handling drawings, schedules, and records.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not equal high risk. Because on-site work is difficult to standardize, machines struggle to replace the physical craft of wiring, connection, and installation. The real concern is remaining a helper without earning credentials. Demand for qualified electricians remains persistent, and helper work is only the starting point.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Studying electrical or electromechanical technology at a vocational school or college is the standard route. Earn an electrician certificate and occupational qualification while enrolled. Electrical work rewards experience and offers a clear career path, despite a demanding start.

Make qualification your first goal, then study emerging fields such as smart homes and new-energy charging stations outside work. Every skill learned during the helper period raises your value after advancement.

Physical stamina and a willingness to learn can provide entry. Choosing the right mentor matters more than starting pay. Earn a low-voltage electrician certificate within one year and advance from helper to independent electrician for a substantial income increase.

When hiring helpers, prioritize attitude and willingness to learn. A defined qualification path significantly reduces turnover. Helpers willing to learn intelligent-device installation are the future foundation of an electrical team.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Basic wire-stripping, crimping, and fastening tools
Cutting cable channels, drilling, and fastening
Scheduling, work reporting, and acceptance photos

ai_s7_trends: Smart homes and new-energy charging stations are creating electrical-installation demand. Electricians with new technical skills are more competitive, expanding the window for helpers to advance.
Prefabrication and modular construction reduce on-site channel cutting, but demand for field connection, commissioning, and repair remains stable.
As AI-assisted design and diagnosis spread, electricians will shift from following drawings to becoming judgment-based technicians who use intelligent tools.

body: Electrician helpers support licensed electricians by handing over tools and materials, cutting cable channels, assisting with wiring, and cleaning worksites while gaining practical electrical experience on construction and electromechanical projects.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能帮你画图、排料、查故障，但工地上的电线和螺丝，还是要一双手一根根接起来。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年电工帮工在岗约 6.66 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 6.67 万人，净增约 0.01 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.68 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.99 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代电工帮工，但这个岗位本来就是过渡性的——它的价值在于把你送进「持证电工」的大门。AI 接管了图纸生成、材料排程、故障诊断这些案头活，但现场布线、接线、安装和检修的体力手艺，机器替代不了。对帮工来说，真正的风险不是 AI，而是「一直停在打下手、不考证转正」。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助电气故障排查
智能家居与智能配电安装需求上升
BIM 与数字化施工图纸普及
预制化线槽与装配式施工减少开槽量
ai_s2_auto: 材料清单与图纸自动生成
工地排程与工具清点管理
布线记录与验收资料电子化
安全培训与规程在线化
ai_s3_list: 现场体力手艺：拉线、开槽、接线，机器进不了施工现场。
与师傅的配合默契：帮工的价值在「跟得上节奏、递得到位」。
临场安全判断：高处、带电环境的自我保护，靠经验和规矩。
看图识物：把图纸和实物对上号，是转正的基础功。
成长路径的执行力：考证、跟学、积累工时，只能自己走。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业的流程与辅助工作正被自动化——图纸、排程、记录都有系统代劳。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。恰恰因为现场作业标准化程度低，布线、接线和安装的体力手艺很难被机器替代。真正该担心的是「一直当帮工不考证」——转正电工的岗位缺口长期存在，帮工只是起点。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读电气、机电相关职校或大专是正路，在校考取电工证和职业资格。电工是越老越吃香的技术活，职业路径清晰，别嫌起步辛苦。
把「转正考证」当第一目标，业余学智能家居、新能源充电桩等新方向。帮工期每多学一项，出师后的身价就高一分。
有体力、肯学习就能入行，跟对师傅比工资重要。一年内把低压电工证考下来，从帮工转独立电工，收入立涨。
招帮工看重态度和学习意愿，给帮工规划考照路径能显著降低流失。愿意学智能设备安装的帮工，是未来电工团队的种子。

ai_s7_trends: 智能家居与新能源充电桩带动电气安装新需求，会新技术的电工更抢手，帮工转正窗口变大。
预制化与装配式施工减少现场开槽，但接线、调试和检修的现场人力需求稳定。
AI 辅助设计诊断普及后，电工从「按图施工」转向「会用智能工具的判断型技师」。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Filters can beautify selfies, but applying makeup on set, sculpting special effects, and making last-minute changes still depend on the makeup artist.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 7,000 artists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 7,600 by 2034, a net increase of about 600 jobs, with around 1,100 openings annually and a 2026 median annual wage of about $50,300 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Makeup Artists, Theatrical And Performance, but it will reduce routine makeup trials. Beauty filters and AR try-ons speed up selfies and color testing, shifting makeup artists from "everyday makeup" toward "character creation, special-effects sculpting, on-set adjustments, and styling direction." Artists limited to basic beautification face the greatest pressure, while those who can interpret a script and sculpt a character become more valuable.

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this career in the moderate AI exposure tier. Systems are accelerating routine makeup trials, but character work and special effects still leave a central role for people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate AI exposure does not equal high risk. What faces replacement is "filter-style basic beautification," not the combined role of "script interpretation + sculpting + on-set adaptation." Artists with aesthetic judgment and strong revision skills become scarcer and more valuable as tools improve efficiency.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start with art studies and vocational training, build a substantial portfolio, and begin practicing special-effects work early as demand for basic beauty makeup contracts.
Advance from "everyday makeup" to "character + special effects," and study facial structure.
Highlight production experience and portfolio work, clearly stating which productions you have worked on.
When hiring, look beyond speed. Assess whether candidates can interpret characters and sculpt forms.

ai_s7_trends: Filters spread, reducing routine makeup work.
Opportunities in special effects and character work grow.
Artists who understand scripts are in greater demand.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can identify an infarct on an image within seconds, but a physician must decide face to face whether the patient should receive thrombolysis and whether the family can accept it.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 8,300 neurologists employed in 2024, projected to rise to 8,800 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 500 jobs, with roughly 300 annual openings. Median annual pay in 2024 was ≥$239,200 (highest BLS OES category, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace neurologists, but it will restructure supporting tasks. AI greatly accelerates imaging interpretation, EEG analysis, medical documentation, and literature searches. Core responsibilities such as diagnosis, treatment selection, and explaining the condition remain with physicians, especially in time-critical stroke emergencies, where final judgment and accountability always rest on the physician's shoulders.
ai_s2_accel: AI stroke-recognition systems flagging thrombolysis windows and supporting decisions
Quantitative assessment of movement disorders such as Parkinsonian tremor
Automated scoring of cognitive-impairment screening scales
Digital therapeutics and rehabilitation apps supporting long-term management
ai_s2_auto: Automated annotation and lesion detection in CT/MRI imaging
Assisted interpretation of EEG and electromyography reports
Automated generation of medical records and discharge summaries
Instant literature searches and evidence-based knowledge retrieval
ai_s3_list: Clinical reasoning: combining symptoms, signs, and imaging into a complete diagnosis.
Physician-patient communication: explaining complex conditions so families understand and cooperate.
Emergency decisions: making and accepting responsibility for judgments within seconds during the thrombolysis window.
Compassionate care: comforting and supporting people facing irreversible disease.
Lifelong learning: translating new research and guidelines into clinical practice.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 6/10 score means AI can strongly assist imaging interpretation, documentation, and information retrieval in neurology. However, the occupation centers on diagnosis + patient management, making AI an efficiency tool rather than a substitute for accountable clinical decisions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium-to-high exposure does not mean high risk. Physicians who use AI imaging tools and recognize AI blind spots can double their efficiency, while those who reject new tools and rely solely on experience will feel pressure. The real moat is clinical judgment supported by AI + patient trust.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Medical education is a long-term investment: undergraduate study + residency + specialty training can easily take ten years. Students who genuinely love clinical work and handle pressure can pursue it while building English and research skills. Those concerned about the timeline can first explore rehabilitation medicine, neurophysiology, and related specialties.

Master AI imaging interpretation and stroke-support systems to build a workflow combining AI assistance + personal review. Deep specialization in stroke centers, intervention, and subspecialties can improve both income and career security.

For physicians moving into medical-imaging AI or health data, a clinical background is a scarce asset. Transitions into management or insurance underwriting are also viable. Demonstrate experience with difficult cases and high-stakes decisions.

When hiring neurologists, look beyond education to emergency decision-making and reputation for physician-patient communication. Equip stroke teams with strong AI tools and stress-reduction mechanisms to retain talent.

ai_s7_trends: AI imaging and stroke-support systems become standard in neurology, shifting physicians toward decision-maker + reviewer roles.
Population aging increases demand for chronic-disease care such as stroke and cognitive impairment, leaving neurologists in persistent shortage.
Digital therapeutics and remote follow-up spread, extending physicians' work from hospital wards into home management.

body: Neurologists diagnose and treat nervous-system diseases, including cerebrovascular disease, epilepsy, movement disorders, neuroimmune disorders, and peripheral neuropathies. They identify causes through history, examination, diagnostic tests, and imaging and develop medication.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能在几秒内标出影像上的梗死灶，但「这个患者要不要溶栓、家属能不能接受」，得医生当面定夺。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年神经科医师在岗约 0.83 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.88 万人，净增约 0.05 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.03 万个职位空缺，2024 年中位数年薪 ≥$239,200（BLS OES 最高档，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代神经科医师，但会重构辅助环节：影像判读、脑电分析、病历文书、文献检索都被 AI 大幅提速。诊断决策、治疗选择、病情告知这些核心职责仍属医生——尤其是卒中这种时间窗极短的急救，最后的判断和责任始终在医生肩上。
ai_s2_accel: AI 卒中识别系统提示溶栓窗口与决策
帕金森震颤等运动障碍的量化评估
认知障碍筛查量表自动评分
数字疗法与康复 App 辅助长期管理
ai_s2_auto: 影像（CT/MRI）自动标注与病灶检出
脑电、肌电报告的辅助判读
病历文书与出院小结自动生成
文献检索与循证知识即时检索
ai_s3_list: 临床推理：把症状、体征、影像拼成完整诊断。
医患沟通：把复杂的病情讲得家属听得懂、愿意配合。
急救决策：溶栓窗口期里几秒钟的判断与担责。
人文关怀：面对不可逆疾病的安抚与支持。
终身学习：把新研究、新指南转化为临床实践。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明神经科的影像判读、文书和检索环节高度可被 AI 辅助，但整个职业围绕「诊断决策 + 患者管理」展开，AI 是提效工具，不会替代需要担责的临床决策。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：会用 AI 影像工具、能识别 AI 盲区的医生效率翻倍；而拒绝新工具、只凭经验的医生会感受到压力。真正的护城河是「AI 辅助下的临床判断 + 医患信任」。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学医是长线投入：本科 + 规培 + 专科培训动辄十年。真心热爱临床、能扛压的孩子可以走，建议把英语和科研能力一并练好；担心周期的，可以先了解康复医学、神经电生理等专科方向。
把 AI 影像判读、卒中辅助系统用熟，形成「AI 辅助 + 自己把关」的工作流。往卒中中心、介入和亚专科深耕，是收入与职业安全感双提升的方向。
医生转行做医学影像 AI、医疗数据等方向，你的临床背景是稀缺资产；想转管理或保险核保也可行。展示你处理过的高难度病例和决策经验。
招神经科医生别只看学历，要看急救决策能力和医患沟通口碑；给卒中团队配好 AI 工具和减压机制，人才能留得住。

ai_s7_trends: AI 影像与卒中辅助系统成为神经科标配，医生向「决策者 + 把关人」转型。
老龄化推高卒中、认知障碍等慢病需求，神经科长期供不应求。
数字疗法与远程随访普及，医生的工作边界从病房延伸到居家管理。

body: Paperhangers apply wallpaper and wallcoverings to walls, matching patterns, joining seams, and finishing edges to create smooth, bubble-free surfaces.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can absorb much of the repetitive, structurable work of Paperhangers, but judgment, accountability, and interpersonal coordination still rest with people. What actually gets squeezed out is pure execution.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能吞掉裱糊工的大量重复与可结构化任务，但判断、责任与人际协调仍由人扛；真正被挤掉的是纯执行层。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年裱糊工在岗约 0.23 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.25 万人，净增约 0.02 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.02 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.83 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代裱糊工，但会重塑Paperhangers的作业流：把重复与可结构化任务交给工具，人聚焦判断、责任与创造。真正被挤掉的是照本宣科式执行，会结合真实场景、会决策的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 用数据画像加速Paperhangers的客情/学情判断。
用模拟与沙盘加速Paperhangers的方案推演。
用检索增强Paperhangers的资料与法规查证。
用协作工具加速Paperhangers的跨团队协同。
ai_s2_auto: 自动生成Paperhangers相关的结构化文档与报告。
对Paperhangers的重复性数据处理与归类。
基于规则的Paperhangers初步筛查与排程。
Paperhangers知识库检索与要点提取。
ai_s3_list: 真实Paperhangers场景下的专业判断与权衡。
把Paperhangers专业知识讲给外行听的表达力。
Paperhangers领域的责任承担与终审。
跨边界的Paperhangers资源整合与人际协调。
Paperhangers长期经验的隐性知识复用。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 评分逻辑：Paperhangers可被 AI 辅助，但「专业判断」与「责任终审」难替代，故4/10 曝光。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 把 4/10 变成优势：用 AI 解放重复劳动，把时间花在真实项目、判断与人际上。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 先把Paperhangers基础打牢，积累真实项目。
用既有经验对接Paperhangers，找差异化切口。
把Paperhangers经验产品化/管理化，放大杠杆。
用 AI 解放Paperhangers重复劳动，聚焦决策。

ai_s7_trends: 一是Paperhangers与 AI 协同成为常态，工具素养成门槛。
二是Paperhangers的高价值判断与责任环节更稀缺。
三是Paperhangers岗位向「专业 + 管理/产品」复合演进。

body: 裱糊工（Paperhangers）在墙面铺贴壁纸与墙布，对花、拼缝、收边，让一面墙平整无泡。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能吞掉裱糊工的大量重复与可结构化任务，但判断、责任与人际协调仍由人扛；真正被挤掉的是纯执行层。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can automate layout, color separation, and one-click proofing, but balancing the color difference between screen and paper still requires someone who understands the process.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 26,200 prepress technicians and workers were employed in 2024, falling to a projected 22,300 by 2034, a net decrease of about 3,900 jobs, with approximately 2,800 openings annually. Median annual pay was about $47,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI is replacing part of prepress technicians' work. Automated layout, AI imposition, intelligent color separation, and cloud proofing are increasingly mature, shrinking purely operational roles. Yet color management, printability judgment, complex process handling, and confirming with clients whether an effect can actually be printed still require process expertise.
ai_s2_accel: AI color management automatically matching brand-color standards
On-demand digital printing proofs shorten delivery cycles
Cross-media color adaptation tools for screens, print, and packaging
Intelligent file checks catch errors early
ai_s2_auto: Widespread automated layout and intelligent imposition tools
Automated AI color separation and color conversion
Automated cloud proofing and file preflight
Automated printability checks
ai_s3_list: Color-process judgment: balancing colors across screens, proofs, and finished products.
Printability experience: controlling process parameters for different papers and inks.
Complex file handling: repairing difficult files across software and platforms.
Client communication: explain printing limitations in a way clients understand and accept.
Quality assurance: human eyes catch layout and process problems AI misses.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 means AI is taking over much of the operational work. Layout, color separation, and preflight can all be automated, so purely operational roles are shrinking fastest. Color management and process judgment remain high-value areas; the high score applies to tool-driven work, not to people with process expertise.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure is not a dead end. Prepress professionals who understand color management and printing processes and can adapt across media remain sought after by packaging companies and brand clients. Pure layout and platemaking roles are the main concentration of AI displacement.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Do not let your child study only layout and platemaking, the area most exposed to AI replacement. Study printing engineering, packaging engineering, or graphic design, and build strong color-management and printing-process skills to pursue a process specialist path.

Move from operational prepress into color management, printing processes, and cross-media adaptation. Earn a G7 or color-management certification and advance from a layout-only tool operator to a process expert.

People with design or printing backgrounds can add color-management and imposition skills before transitioning. New entrants should prioritize digital printing workflows and file preflight, where near-term demand remains.

Design prepress roles toward process consulting. Professionals who can work with brand clients, develop color plans, and solve difficult file problems deserve premium pay; automate purely operational work wherever practical.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automatic checks for text, bleed, and fonts
Seamless handoff from file to print

ai_s7_trends: As AI layout and cloud proofing spread, purely operational prepress roles contract faster.
Demand for packaging printing and consistent brand colors is rising, making color-management talent scarce.
Prepress is shifting from platemaking worker to printing-process consultant, with cross-media adaptation becoming a core capability.

body: Prepress technicians convert design files into printable form, including layout, color management and separation, sheet imposition, proof inspection, and printability processing. They are the final checkpoint before printing in the production chain.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can automate layout, color separation, and one-click proofing, but balancing the color difference between screen and paper still requires someone who understands the process.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动排版、自动分色、一键打样，但屏幕和纸张之间那层「颜色差异」，还得靠懂工艺的人来平衡。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年技术员工人在岗约 2.62 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.23 万人，岗位净减约 0.39 万个，年均产生约 0.28 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.73 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 正在取代印前技术员的一部分工作：自动排版、AI 拼版、智能分色和云端打样越来越成熟，纯操作型印前岗位在收缩。但色彩管理、印刷适性判断、复杂工艺处理，以及跟客户确认「这个效果能不能印出来」，依然需要懂工艺的人。
ai_s2_accel: AI 色彩管理自动匹配品牌色标准
数字印刷按需打样缩短交付周期
跨媒介（屏显/印刷/包装）色彩适配工具
智能文件检查提前拦截错误
ai_s2_auto: 自动排版与智能拼版工具普及
AI 分色与色彩转换自动化
云端打样与文件预检自动化
印刷适性检查的自动化
ai_s3_list: 色彩工艺判断：屏幕、样张、成品之间的颜色平衡。
印刷适性经验：不同纸张油墨的工艺参数把握。
复杂文件处理：跨软件、跨平台的疑难文件修复。
客户沟通：把印刷限制讲得客户理解并接受。
质量兜底：AI 查不出的版式与工艺问题，靠人眼兜住。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这行的「操作型」环节正被 AI 大面积接管——排版、分色、预检都能自动化，纯操作岗收缩最快；但色彩管理和工艺判断仍是高价值环节，评分高的是工具化部分，不是懂工艺的人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于末路：会色彩管理、懂印刷工艺、能做跨媒介适配的印前人才，在包装和品牌客户那里依然抢手。纯排版、纯制版的操作岗，才是被 AI 替代的集中区。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 别让孩子只学纯排版制版，那是 AI 替代的重灾区。学印刷工程、包装工程或平面设计，把色彩管理和印刷工艺学扎实，往工艺师方向走才有前途。
从操作型印前转向色彩管理、印刷工艺和跨媒介适配。考个 G7 或色彩管理认证，把「只会排版的工具人」升级成「懂工艺的专家」。
有设计或印刷背景的，补色彩管理和拼版技能再切入；纯想入门的话，优先学数字印刷流程和文件预检，这些环节短期还有需求。
印前岗要往「工艺顾问」方向设计：能对接品牌客户、做色彩方案、解决疑难文件的印前人才值得高薪；纯操作岗能自动化就自动化。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 设备色彩配置文件管理
文字、出血、字体自动检查
自动匹配品牌色彩标准
文件到印刷的无缝衔接

ai_s7_trends: AI 排版与云端打样普及，纯操作型印前岗位加速收缩。
包装印刷与品牌色彩一致性需求上升，色彩管理人才稀缺。
印前从「制版工」转向「印刷工艺顾问」，跨媒介适配成为核心能力。

body: 印前技术员负责把设计文件转换为可印刷状态，包括排版、色彩管理与分色、拼大版、打样检查与印刷适性处理，是印刷生产链中「开印前的最后一道关卡」。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can organize reports, work orders, and payment records clearly, but when owners argue in a group chat, a person still has to respond to the long message, absorb the emotion, and offer a solution.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 466,100 property, real estate, and community association managers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 483,100 by 2034, a net increase of about 17,000 jobs, with about 39,000 openings annually. Median annual pay was about $66,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace property managers, but it will automate a great deal of paperwork. Software can handle budget reports, work-order dispatch, payment reminders, and vendor contract management. The core of property management is coordinating people and handling issues on site. Leaks do not stop themselves, and AI cannot calm an angry owner.
ai_s2_accel: Smart property platforms integrating payments, repair requests, and inspections
AI cameras assisting security and anomaly detection
Data analysis predicting equipment maintenance needs
Owner apps enabling online communication and voting
ai_s2_auto: Automated property fee billing and payment reminders
Work-order dispatch and repair progress tracking
Automated generation of financial reports and budgets
Digital vendor contracts and procurement processes
ai_s3_list: Managing owners' emotions: remaining composed when criticized.
Multi-party coordination: balancing the interests of owners, the company, and vendors.
Emergency decisions: judging quickly during a late-night leak or power outage.
Budgeting and negotiation: explaining costs and negotiating prices down.
Regulations and relationships: following rules while remaining flexible.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 means the process layer of this work has substantial automation potential. Software and AI can handle reports, work orders, payments, and inspections, but the property manager's core value lies in on-site problem solving and interpersonal coordination, which are among the hardest parts to automate.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean jobs disappear. Managers who use smart property platforms and understand data reports can oversee larger portfolios, while old methods based only on staying on site and chasing payments will be eliminated. Digitalization is a tool; being able to support owners is the real skill.

ai_s5_persona.建议: The property industry has a low entry barrier and substantial demand, making it suitable for young people seeking stability. Study property management, earn a property project manager certificate, and begin an internship in resident service. The field values conflict-resolution ability more than academic credentials.

Master smart property platforms, financial software, and data analysis, then advance from managing one community to managing multiple projects or commercial properties. Earn a property management credential and move toward asset operations rather than remaining limited to fee collection.

People with customer service, administration, finance, or engineering backgrounds transition smoothly into property management, where project manager roles value combined experience. In interviews, explaining a difficult incident you handled and how you coordinated it is more useful than discussing theory.

When hiring project managers, look beyond certificates and emphasize complaint-handling cases + financial awareness + resilience. Train current managers on smart property tools; teams lacking digital capability struggle to manage large projects.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Integrated payments, repair requests, and inspections
Detection of abnormal behavior and safety hazards
Online repair requests, payments, and voting

ai_s7_trends: As smart property platforms spread, property managers shift from collecting fees and arranging repairs to data-driven operations.
In the era of existing housing stock, property management is expanding from managing communities to managing and operating assets.
Owners demand greater service transparency, making compliance and service reputation decisive.

body: Property, real estate, and community association managers oversee the daily operations of residential communities, commercial buildings, and homeowners' associations. They coordinate budgets and finances, facility maintenance, vendor services, owner communication, and community affairs, directly managing property assets and community order.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能替你把报表、工单和缴费记录整理得明明白白，但业主在群里吵起来的那条长消息，还是得人出来接住情绪、给出方案。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年物业、房地产与社区协会经理在岗约 46.61 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 48.31 万人，净增约 1.70 万个岗位，年均产生约 3.90 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.67 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代物业经理，但会把大量文书活自动化：预算报表、工单派发、缴费提醒、供应商合同管理都能交给软件。物业管理的核心是「人跟人协调、人到场处理」，漏水不会自己止住，业主的怒气 AI 也哄不好。
ai_s2_accel: 智慧物业平台整合缴费、报修与巡检
AI 摄像头辅助安保与异常检测
数据分析预判设备维护需求
业主端 App 实现线上沟通与投票
ai_s2_auto: 物业费账单与缴费提醒自动化
工单派发与维修进度跟踪
财务报表与预算自动化生成
供应商合同与采购流程数字化
ai_s3_list: 业主情绪处理：被骂时还能稳住局面。
多方协调：业主、公司、供应商的利益平衡。
应急决策：半夜漏水停电时的快速判断。
预算与谈判：把成本讲清楚、把价谈下来。
法规与人情：按规矩办事也懂变通。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这行的「流程层」自动化程度不低：报表、工单、缴费、巡检都能交给软件和 AI，但物业经理的核心价值在「现场处理和人际协调」，这些恰恰是自动化最难替代的部分。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于岗位消失：会用智慧物业平台、看得懂数据报表的经理，能管更大规模的项目；只靠「蹲现场催费」的老办法会被淘汰。数字化是工具，接得住业主才是本事。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 物业行业门槛不高、缺口大，适合求稳的孩子。读物业管理相关专业、考物业项目经理证，实习从客服管家干起；提醒孩子，这行吃的不是学历，是处理矛盾的能力。
把智慧物业平台、财务软件和数据分析用熟，从「管一个小区」向「管多个项目/商业物业」走。考物业管理师，往资产运营方向转型，别停在催费层面。
有客服、行政、财务或工程背景的人转物业很顺，项目经理岗位很看重这些复合经验。面试时讲清你处理过什么棘手事件、怎么协调的，比谈理论有用。
项目经理招聘别只看证书，把「处理投诉案例 + 财务意识 + 抗压」作为重点；给在岗经理配智慧物业工具培训，数字化能力跟不上的团队很难管好大型项目。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 异常行为与安全隐患检测

ai_s7_trends: 智慧物业平台普及，物业经理从「催费管修」转向「数据运营」。
存量房时代到来，物业从管小区走向管资产、做经营。
业主对服务透明度要求提高，合规与服务口碑决定去留。

body: 物业、房地产与社区协会经理负责住宅小区、商业楼宇与业主协会的日常运营，统筹预算财务、设施维护、供应商服务、业主沟通与社区事务，是物业资产和社区秩序的直接管理。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 144,500 psychiatric technicians were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 173,300 by 2034, a net increase of about 28,800 jobs, with about 15,900 openings annually. Median annual pay was about $42,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace psychiatric technicians, but it will take over documentation and alerts. Scale scoring, care notes, and risk warnings can all be automated, shifting technicians' time from writing to accompanying and watching patients. Machines cannot replace face-to-face observation, reassurance, and care on the ward.
ai_s2_accel: AI risk-warning models flagging behavioral abnormalities
Wearable devices monitoring sleep and activity
Digital rehabilitation activities and VR-assisted training
Remote monitoring extending community care coverage
ai_s2_auto: Automated generation of care notes and scale scores
Digital scheduling and shift handoff records
Digital patient files and follow-up information
Automated management of rehabilitation activity schedules and materials
ai_s3_list: Ward observation: detecting changes in tone, expression, and behavior.
Crisis response: remaining calm during emotional dysregulation or self-harm risk.
Reassuring communication: helping patients cooperate and speak honestly.
Rehabilitation organization: making activities patients want to join.
Protecting safety: maintaining constant vigilance for abnormalities.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 means AI is assisting documentation and warnings, but the core of psychiatric care is face-to-face observation and companionship. Judgment, reassurance, and protection on the ward depend on technicians' experience and commitment, limiting replacement.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: There is no need to panic about moderately high exposure. AI risk alerts and digital records make technicians more efficient, freeing time for rehabilitation activities and deeper companionship. Care staff who use these tools are more welcome as the sector expands.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Before entering the field, confirm that you can accept night shifts and an emotionally intense work environment, ideally through an internship. Nursing, psychology, and social work all provide entry routes, while psychiatric role allowances and scarcity are advantages.

Build strong crisis-response and rehabilitation activity skills and learn digital records and risk-warning tools. Further study and certification toward psychiatric nursing or rehabilitation therapy can improve both income and professional value.

People with backgrounds in nursing, social work, or special education can transition relatively smoothly, but should complete systematic training before entering a ward. In interviews, experience handling emotionally intense situations is more compelling than certificates.

Psychiatric care roles have high turnover. Combine risk allowances + psychological support + promotion paths to retain staff. Equipping teams with risk-warning and digital documentation tools can reduce frontline burdens.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Follow-up on status outside the facility

ai_s7_trends: As AI risk warnings and digital records spread, technicians shift from writing notes to accompanying patients.
Expansion of mental health services continues to increase demand for ward care roles.
As rehabilitation activities become digital, technicians who organize activities and use new tools are more sought after.

body: Psychiatric technicians provide daily care and monitor patients' conditions in psychiatric facilities. They observe and document patient status, organize rehabilitation activities, assist with medication management, and implement safety and crisis intervention measures.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年精神科技术员在岗约 14.45 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 17.33 万人，净增约 2.88 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.59 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.26 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代精神科技术员，但会接管记录与预警：量表评分、护理记录、风险提示都能自动化，技术员的时间从「写」转向「陪和守」。病房里面对面的观察、安抚与照护，机器替代不了。
ai_s2_accel: AI 风险预警模型提示行为异常
可穿戴设备监测睡眠与活动状态
数字化康复活动与 VR 训练辅助

ai_s2_auto: 护理记录与量表评分自动生成

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明记录和预警正被 AI 辅助，但精神科照护的核心是「面对面的观察与陪伴」，病房里的判断、安抚与守护依赖技术员的经验与投入，替代度有限。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不必慌：AI 风险预警和数字化记录能让技术员更高效，省下的时间用来做康复活动和深度陪伴。会用工具的照护人员，在行业扩容中更受欢迎。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想入行先确认孩子能接受夜班和高情绪浓度的工作环境，最好先实习体验。护理、心理、社工专业都可以作为入口，精神科方向的岗位补贴和稀缺度是加分项。
把危机处置和康复活动组织做扎实，学数字化记录和风险预警工具；往精神科护士、康复治疗师方向考证进修，是收入与职业价值双提升的路径。
有护理、社工、特教背景的转岗较顺；先接受系统培训再进病房。面试时突出你处理过高情绪浓度场景的经历，比证书更打动招聘方。
精神科照护岗流失率高，建议用「风险补贴 + 心理支持 + 晋升通道」组合留人；给团队配风险预警和数字化记录工具，能减轻一线负担。

ai_s7_trends: AI 风险预警与数字化记录普及，技术员从「写记录」转向「陪患者」。
